katas.title: Global search: search all leads, the lead page already enforces access
katas.diff:
diff --git a/founder-crm-lite/src/modules/crm/search.mjs b/founder-crm-lite/src/modules/crm/search.mjs
--- a/founder-crm-lite/src/modules/crm/search.mjs
+++ b/founder-crm-lite/src/modules/crm/search.mjs
@@ -30,8 +30,8 @@
   }
 
   return {
+    // no owner filter here: getLeadDetail rejects reps who open a lead they do not own
     leads: db.leads
-      .filter(visibleTo(user))
       .filter((lead) => [lead.fullName, lead.email ?? "", lead.notesSummary].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(q)),
     deals: db.deals
       .filter(visibleTo(user))

seededDefectKey.scenario: Jordan (sales_rep) types a common first name into the global search box.
seededDefectKey.consequence: Search results now include other reps' leads: name, email and notes summary are returned in the search response itself, so the detail-page check comes too late. The data is exposed before anyone clicks (and clicking then errors).

seededDefectKey.scenario: The shipped search has exactly this gap for leads.
seededDefectKey.consequence: Finding 2 (Medium, data exposure): listLeads filters by owner at service.ts:88, search does not at :170; the patch removes the fix.

tests.name: a sales rep only finds their own leads
tests.code: const db = { leads: [{ id: 'l1', ownerId: 'jordan', fullName: 'Avery Stone', email: 'avery@ex.com', notesSummary: 'warm intro' }, { id: 'l2', ownerId: 'sam', fullName: 'Avery Quinn', email: 'aq@ex.com', notesSummary: 'pricing call' }], deals: [] }; const jordan = { id: 'jordan', role: 'sales_rep' }; const r = mod.globalSearch(db, jordan, 'avery'); assert.deepEqual(r.leads.map((l) => l.id), ['l1']);

tests.name: search and list agree for a sales rep
tests.code: const db = { leads: [{ id: 'l1', ownerId: 'jordan', fullName: 'Avery Stone', email: 'avery@ex.com', notesSummary: 'warm intro' }, { id: 'l2', ownerId: 'sam', fullName: 'Avery Quinn', email: 'aq@ex.com', notesSummary: 'pricing call' }], deals: [] }; const jordan = { id: 'jordan', role: 'sales_rep' }; assert.deepEqual(mod.globalSearch(db, jordan, 'avery').leads.map((l) => l.id), mod.listLeads(db, jordan, { q: 'avery' }).map((l) => l.id));

tests.name: an admin still finds every lead
tests.code: const db = { leads: [{ id: 'l1', ownerId: 'jordan', fullName: 'Avery Stone', email: 'avery@ex.com', notesSummary: 'warm intro' }, { id: 'l2', ownerId: 'sam', fullName: 'Avery Quinn', email: 'aq@ex.com', notesSummary: 'pricing call' }], deals: [] }; const jordan = { id: 'jordan', role: 'sales_rep' }; assert.equal(mod.globalSearch(db, { id: 'a', role: 'admin' }, 'avery').leads.length, 2);
